statement: Debilitated — the weakest classical dignity, directly opposite the planet's exaltation. Its significations are hardest to access here, though classical technique also allows for Neecha Bhanga (debilitation-cancellation) under specific chart conditions not evaluated by this dignity computation.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
